# One {#sec:one}

::: {.theorem #thm:t title="Unrelated"}
Exercises have their own counter, so this theorem does not shift them.
:::

::: {.exercise #ex:sum title="A sum"}
Show that $1+2+\dots+n=n(n+1)/2$.

::: solution
Pair the terms: $(1+n)+(2+n-1)+\dots$ gives $n/2$ pairs of $n+1$.

A second paragraph.
